async function originalMustStayPaused(page:Page,old:any,raw:any,info:TestInfo,name:string){await expect(page.getByTestId('preparation-plan-state')).toContainText('已保存');await expect(page.getByTestId('training-resume')).toBeEnabled();await reach(page,['preparation-start','training-resume'],info,name);await expect(page.getByTestId('preparation-start')).toBeDisabled();await expect(page.getByTestId('preparation-start').locator('..')).toContainText('继续');const estimate=page.getByTestId('preparation-estimate');await expect(estimate).toBeVisible();await expect(estimate.getByTestId('paused-plan-progress')).toHaveText('原段已暂停 · 已完成 '+old.completedCycles+' / '+old.plan.maxCycles+' '+(old.plan.kind==='learn'?'卷':'件'));expect(await estimate.innerText()).not.toMatch(/预计(?:完成|成交)|研习清单中已有掌握/);expect(await activity(page)).toEqual(old);expect(await database(page)).toEqual(raw);}

async function originalMustStayPaused(page:Page,old:any,raw:any,info:TestInfo,name:string){await expect(page.getByTestId('preparation-plan-state')).toContainText('已保存');await expect(page.getByTestId('training-resume')).toBeEnabled();await reach(page,['preparation-start','training-resume'],info,name);await expect(page.getByTestId('preparation-start')).toBeDisabled();await expect(page.getByTestId('preparation-start').locator('..')).toContainText('继续');const learning=old.plan.kind==='learn';if(learning)await openLearningSettings(page);const estimate=page.getByTestId(learning?'learning-full-estimate':'preparation-estimate');await expect(estimate).toBeVisible();await expect(estimate.getByTestId('paused-plan-progress')).toHaveText('原段已暂停 · 已完成 '+old.completedCycles+' / '+old.plan.maxCycles+' '+(old.plan.kind==='learn'?'卷':'件'));const actual=learning?(await estimate.getByTestId('paused-plan-progress').innerText())+' '+await estimate.locator('[data-testid=paused-plan-progress]+small').innerText():await estimate.innerText();expect(actual).not.toMatch(/预计(?:完成|成交)|研习清单中已有掌握/);if(learning){await expect(estimate).toContainText('新安排预演');await closeLearningSettings(page);}expect(await activity(page)).toEqual(old);expect(await database(page)).toEqual(raw);}
